Returns HTTP 500 for a non-existent/invalid customer id; should return 404 (or 400 for malformed ObjectId).

(Minor) Handle invalid/nonexistent customer id in /api/customers/{id}/360 -> return 404 instead of 500.

rca of the issue: For _id leak: customer_360 serializes the customer document without popping '_id'. For 500 on invalid id: no try/except around ObjectId(cid) conversion; PyMongo raises InvalidId which becomes 500. Fix: wrap conversion in try/except and return 404; and delete _id before returning.
